# SpeechRouter

> One API for every speech model: 12 STT providers (Deepgram, Soniox,
> AssemblyAI, OpenAI, Speechmatics, Azure, AWS, Google, Groq, Mistral,
> ElevenLabs, Cartesia) behind one key, one schema, one bill. Mid-stream
> failover. Vendor list prices, 0% markup. Open source (Apache-2.0).

Base URL: https://api.speechrouter.ai — streaming: wss .../v1/listen ·
batch: POST /v1/audio/transcriptions · catalog: GET /v1/models (no auth).
SDKs: `npm install speechrouter` / Python: install from the repo (PyPI package coming soon): pip install "git+https://github.com/speech-router/speechrouter.git#subdirectory=packages/sdk-python"
